# Frankie 1.1.21
- Keeps an existing Messages sending permission when Messages.app is closed. - Adds a separate Open permissions action to the Messages readiness panel. - Refresh status now uses the latest Mac heartbeat and can unblock an existing preview. - Runs the macOS Automation permission probe off the main UI thread.
